title: What does the integral symbol actually do?

lines.text: {chart} If this is your *speed,* how far did you {distq} *go?*

lines.say: Add every strip: about seventeen meters.

lines.text: The total closes in on {converge} exactly *20.*
lines.say: The total closes in on exactly twenty.

lines.text: That's why this *symbol* is a {morph} long *S,* for *sum.*
An integral adds *tiny* pieces into a *whole.*
